## Problem and intended outcome

State the concrete trigger, requirement and expected behavior.

## Change and scope

Describe the implementation and any contract, source-identity or evidence impact.

## Validation

Record commands, results, environment and unresolved failures. Distinguish actual
execution, simulated workers and replay. Link applicable evidence without adding
raw private run files.

## Review

- [ ] The change preserves or explicitly revises the applicable contract.
- [ ] Tests and repository checks cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] Estimates, measurements, AI review and human acceptance are identified accurately.
- [ ] License/provenance notices and the public-data boundary were checked.
- [ ] Known limitations and remaining questions are documented.

Maintainer acceptance: pending. CodeRabbit feedback is advisory and is not a human
review record. Record the maintainer decision on the final reviewed commit.
